longDescription: Understanding Organisational Values. Defining Your Organisational Values. Understanding Business Valuation and its purpose. Understanding Business Value Methods. Understanding Management Theories and their evolution. Strategies to Enhance Organisational Value. Organisational Value Example: Netflix.
